release.release_notes:
Gaia Files replaces the Home Apps button with a controller-friendly browser and manager using Gaia Light/Dark UI. ROMs and Emulator Files tabs use actual Gaia data paths, with console/emulator filters, folder navigation, recursive search, file-type filters and sorting.

Includes multi-selection, copy/move/paste, rename/new folder, recoverable Trash/restore, file details, bounded text and raster-image previews, and a Gaia on-screen keyboard. Advanced mode is explicit and session-only: hidden files, direct paths, OS files and import from readable mounted drives. Core OS files remain read-only; no privileged file service or external desktop file dialogs are used.

Operations refuse overwrites, protected root folders, symbolic-link writes, special-file copies and copying a folder into itself. Copies are staged and cancellable. Cross-filesystem Move is refused; copy, verify and Trash the original instead. There is no permanent deletion or automatic Trash purge. The library rescans after file changes.

Validation: 79 Python cases (18 new real-file regressions), 23 authored QML syntax checks, hidden real-Qt Files flow tests, Debian 13 Qt native build and all five CTest suites. Native Files UI/worker operations and four Light/Dark captures passed, along with the full existing Home/Settings UI suite, in the Debian build jobs. The corrected build passed all new Files checks; an existing held-scroll timing check failed once under load. A bounded runtime-only replay of the exact retained binary passed both Files and the complete existing UI suite, without recompilation.

Exact built source: daad1f777489bd365dc676ff837eecd972fd9c62. QA: https://github.com/t4kas/GaiaOS/actions/runs/41441070842 . Signing and publishing are local; credentials were not put on Actions.

Launcher/application update for Debian 13 amd64; no ISO reinstall is required for this feature on a compatible existing Gaia installation. No ISO or full-system bundle attached. Device/game/media acceptance remains with Chris. Beta only; Stable unchanged.

This supersedes 0.4.8-beta.5 and fixes the controller mapping: X selects items in the Files list, B goes back, Y opens actions. File dialogs still handle X/Close as cancellation. Replay: https://github.com/t4kas/GaiaOS/actions/runs/41442098516 .
